termsUseText: By using Premier Health Clinic's website or booking our services, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. Please read them carefully before use.

contactText: For any inquiries regarding these terms, please contact us at info@premierhealthclinic.com or call +20 120 064 4663.
infoCollectText: When you use our website or book an appointment, we may collect your full name, contact information, health data relevant to your treatments, and payment information.
howUseInfoText: We use your data to schedule appointments, provide personalized medical care, process payments, and send reminders and service updates.
dataSecText: We use SSL encryption and strict security protocols to protect your personal and medical data from unauthorized access.

cookiesText: We use cookies to enhance your website experience and analyze traffic. You can control these through your browser settings.
rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at info@premierhealthclinic.com.
contactPrivacyText: For privacy-related inquiries, contact Premier Health's data privacy support team at info@premierhealthclinic.com or call +20 120 064 4663.
